Junior Software Engineer
Contoh Insurans (Malaysia) Berhad
[2.7](https://my.jobstreet.com/companies/contoh-general-insurance-172535451217543/reviews?jobId=95667394)[View all jobs](https://my.jobstreet.com/Contoh-General-Insurance-jobs/at-this-company)
[Kuala Lumpur City Centre, Kuala Lumpur](https://my.jobstreet.com/Software-Engineer-jobs/in-Kuala-Lumpur-City-Centre-Kuala-Lumpur) (Hybrid)
[Engineering - Software (Information & Communication Technology)](https://my.jobstreet.com/jobs-in-information-communication-technology/engineering-software)
[Full time](https://my.jobstreet.com/Software-Engineer-jobs/full-time)
Salary undisclosed
Posted 4d agoHigh application volume
Responsibilities

* Design, development, testing, and deployment of software & application to meet business objective under organization’s IT projects & initiatives.
* Support & maintenance (2nd Level SLA) of software & application to ensure organization’s Business As Usual (BAU).
* Upgrade of software & application to meet user’s & compliance requirements.
* Research, design & planning for software & application to fulfil business requirement & organization objective.

Requirements

* Degree in Information Technology (IT)/ Computer Science/ Software Engineering or related field.
* Minimum two (2) years’ working experience in Software Engineering or related field, with at least one (1) year of experience in IT-related projects.
* Experience in fullstack development or data engineering is preferred.
* Must have strong analytical, problem-solving, good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Must be proficient in at least one (1) programming language. (C#/ Java/ Javascript or equivalent)
* Must be proficient in SQL & Relational Database (MS SQL / MySQL or equivalent)
* Familiar with software development life cycle (SLDC) and software development tools (IDE, text editor, SQL management tool, source code control, etc.)
* Familiar with web development technologies, standards & protocols.
* Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.


Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:

* Which of the following types of qualifications do you have?
* Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Malaysia?
* How many years' experience do you have as a software engineer?
* What's your expected monthly basic salary?
* Which of the following programming languages are you experienced in?
* Have you worked in a role which requires a sound understanding of the software development lifecycle?

Company profile
Contoh General Insurance
2.7·[3 reviews](https://my.jobstreet.com/companies/contoh-general-insurance-172535451217543/reviews?jobId=95667394)
Insurance101-1,000 employees
Contoh Insurans (Malaysia) Berhad or CIM is a subsidiary of Contoh Asia Pte. Ltd. Singapore and its ultimate holding company is Contoh Insurans Holdings Inc., in Japan. The Contoh Insurans Group has had more than 140 years history in Japan being the oldest and one of the largest insurance group in Japan. The group is engaged in a wide variety of businesses ranging from non-life insurance to life insurance, international insurance, financial and other general business. The Group operates a worldwide network that spans 46 countries and regions to provide safety and security to customers.
